text: Hearth is a private family photo app. A grandparent opens it to see the newest photos from the family. Build the home screen.
Role Radar tracks job openings. A job seeker scans a ranked list of roles each morning. Build the list screen.
Crew Clock lets a small construction crew clock in by phone. A crew member changes how the app uses their location. Build the settings screen.
Crew Clock again. A boss adds a new job site with a name, an address and a radius. Build the form.
ccwatts is a command line tool that estimates the electricity used by coding assistants. A developer decides whether to install it. Build the landing page.
ccwatts shows a week of estimated energy use. A developer checks the week's total and range. Build the dashboard.
Role Radar has no saved jobs yet. A new user needs to know the first step. Build the empty state.
Charlie suggests paper trades. A learner confirms a practice trade. Build the confirmation dialog.
